title: Sharp Hessian inequalities and monotonicity for Green's functions of positively curved Einstein manifolds
summary: We prove a sharp Hessian inequality for the natural comparison Green's function of an Einstein manifold with positive sectional curvature, which may be viewed as a Green's function analogue of the Hessian comparison theorem and as a positively-curved, elliptic counterpart to the matrix Li-Yau-Hamilton inequality for the heat equation. We also show that this inequality is closely related to a family of monotonicity formulae, extending previous results of Park to the setting of positive curvature.
